column1: # Food words used to split German compounds at their head ("Rinderhackfleisch" -> rinder + hackfleisch).
# Written folded: lower case, ä -> ae, ö -> oe, ü -> ue, ß -> ss.
# A word that is NOT listed is split at the longest listed word it ends with (modifier at least 3 letters).
# A listed word is split only into two listed words ("hackfleisch" -> hack + fleisch; "schwein" stays whole).
# So lexicalised compounds are listed whole: "himbeeren" must not become "him" + "beeren" and then match
